Stop work / unsafe conditions — needs confirmation, not action

Five forms carried the "Unsafe conditions" item in the "What did we observe?" multi-select today. Four of them are the pattern Kelby Hammer identified on 09/23 — the selection is made but no narrative on the form describes a specific unsafe condition arising, which points to a training issue in how the list is used rather than to an event. These should be put to the technician for confirmation, not acted on as confirmed incidents. No form today selected "Stop work authority utilized"; where a stop-work item appears it is the routine pre-job item "Stop work authority was discussed".
Selected "Unsafe conditions" with no narrative describing one — needs confirmation:

1099 William Jimmy Cooper — XTO, JOHN BRAUN A UNIT 4 2527SH, job 35468. Also selected "Stop work authority was discussed". The only narrative is "Team work". The same form answers "Did we leave the location better than we found it?: No" while the follow-up field reads "Clean" — the two contradict each other.
Ruben Rojo — XTO, STOUT HUNTER 25I 209H, job 35515. "Unsafe conditions" selected with no stop-work item of either kind. Narrative: "Reconnect on wellhead" and "No gas or crazy readings".

Ruben Rojo — XTO, TEXAS TEN MILES 37A 1H, job 35517. Same selection again the same day. Narrative: "Reconnect went swimmingly, no problems or issues". Two forms, one technician, one day, with narratives that positively contradict the selection — this looks like a selection carried forward rather than made fresh.

Michael Jobe — XTO, BRADFORD TRUST B UNIT 1 1242SH, job 35496. Also selected "Stop work authority was discussed". Narrative: "The crew did much better about putting there zone out", which describes an improvement, not a condition.

Not the mis-selection pattern: Michael Jobe's Watkins-Burkitt form (35394) is different and is reported as real safety concern 2 above. Its narrative names a specific condition — no exclusion zone and no spotter — and a stop work actually taken. Do not group it with the four above.

Repeat appearances: Michael Jobe was on this list twice on 09/26 for selecting "Unsafe conditions" with no supporting narrative, and appears again today on 35496 — that is the same defect on a second day and is worth raising with him directly. Nathan Contreras, who appeared on the 09/23 and 09/26 stop-work confirmation lists, does not appear today; his air job supervision form (35527) carries no OWL section at all.
The inverse, worth reporting: none found today. No form carried a narrative naming a real unsafe condition while leaving "Unsafe conditions" unselected.

Trailer Inspection Forms, Trailer Readiness Forms and the equipment sections of the H2S daily are photo-based. A defect visible only in a photograph will not surface in this review. Fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside the images, not as text, so this review can confirm that a photo was taken and when, but not what it shows. A second limitation applies to today specifically: this review ran at 11:00 PM Central, before the Central day closed, so the usual sweep of the following morning for late-arriving submissions could not be performed. Anything filed for 10/07 that lands overnight or tomorrow morning is not included here, and one or two of the coverage gaps above may close when it arrives.
